about:
# UsefulGDLevels
https://gdcolon.com/usefulgdlevels integration inside Geometry Dash.

You <c-ff0000>***__ARE REQUIRED TO__***</c> use this mod along with [BetterInfo](mod:cvolton.betterinfo) for more precise level list completion tracking.

<mod:cvolton.betterinfo>

Indicates the number of level lists a level is in (if it's in four level lists or more) and your progress on each level list, as well as navigation shortcuts to these levels and level lists.

Made with permission from Colon after a mod suggestion from [Parallex](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCl6Jcm-ePOArJ-NFiHb6cWg).

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.

# UsefulGDLevels Changelog
## v1.2.1
- Find levels you're close to claiming rewards for!
  - <c-aaaaaa>*(Under default settings, use the pink button immediately following the cyan button this mod used to add.)*</c>
  - See the changelog for v1.2.0 to read specific details about which tiebreakers are applied.
## v1.2.0
- Filter levels by specifying a minimum level frequency and/or maximum level length.
  - <c-aaaaaa>*These filters can be used together with the "Maximum Level Difficulty" filter from the mod's initial release.*</c>
- Level sorting based on factors besides list frequency will now happen when using the cyan shortcut button on the level search menu.
  - This setting uses the same tiebreaker system mentioned in v1.1.1's changelog.
  - <c-aaaaaa>*List frequency __has been__ and will __always__ be a factor when pressing "Show Levels" (viewing search results of levels that comprise the incomplete level lists a level appears in).*</c>
- Show information for levels appearing in three or two level lists.
  - <c-aaaaaa>*These levels are ignored by default to preserve the original mod experience.*</c>
- Refactor some things here and there.
- Recategorize some existing settings as a result of introducing new settings.
## v1.1.1
- Display additional map pack/gauntlet information.
  - Incidentally, this also fixes a bug ever since the mod's initial release where some levels might have inaccurate list frequency information. (Map packs were counted as level lists.)
- Revised tiebreaker system introduced in options from v1.1.0:
  - Levels are sorted by their level list frequency, then their length, then star/moon count, then difficulty (as a tiebreaker between different types of demon [10 star] levels, then level ID).
  - Lists are split into claimed and unclaimed lists. In both groups, they are sorted by whether you've completed (but not yet claimed) its diamonds, then how many levels you have left before you can claim the diamonds <c-aaaaaa>*(note: this is NOT the same thing as a percentage)*</c>, then diamond reward count, then the number of levels you need to complete the entire list <c-aaaaaa>*(note: this is NOT the same thing as a percentage)*</c>, then download count, then level list ID.
## v1.1.0
- Sort levels by list frequency in descending order.
- Sort level lists by completion progress in descending order.
- Choose the type of level search layer to show the useful levels shortcut button.

<c-aaaaaa>*Note that tiebreakers may break in some situations. They will be revisited later.*</c>
## v1.0.2
- Putting out even more fires.
## v1.0.1
- Putting out some fires.
## v1.0.0
- Initial release (on GitHub).
